Review checklist

100 historical sales
One state
One named tax owner

Download plain-text copy
01

Define a permissioned sample

Choose seller entity, state, period, selection rule, owner and 100 historical exempt sales. Record scope before accessing documents.

02

Preserve transaction facts

Keep invoice ID, legal buyer, customer mapping, jurisdiction, sale date, currency, value and source row. Avoid duplicate joins.

03

Identify candidate evidence

List certificate ID/version, named entity, state, form, signed date, receipt and source span. Unknown is a meaningful result.

04

Separate date questions

Distinguish actual expiry, blanket period, internal renewal metadata and receipt timing. Do not impose another state’s rule.

05

Review state and form requirements

Use a dated official source. Record missing fields, not-applicable questions and unresolved interpretation.

06

Check the current suite

Ask which alerts, campaigns and packet reports already identify the same question. Count a new gap only after comparison.

07

Classify with the tax owner

Separate true unsupported claims, false warnings, omissions and unknowns. Keep the review basis next to the source.

08

Agree the next action

Assign the owner, remediation requirement and next date. Outreach requires separate approved scripts and recipients.

09

Evaluate the commitment

Count previously unidentified, remediable gaps and review effort. Ask for a scoped, paid pilot decision.

Keep sensitive records out of this website.

The guide is ungated. A real sample needs an agreed transfer, access and retention process.
